subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 7: Review and Get ready for Starters
outcomes: I can use family and face words in sentences.
I can read a description and say if it matches a picture.
I can follow the story "The goat herd".

tf.s: My dad's got brown eyes is a sentence about eyes.
tf.why: Yes! It tells us the colour of dad's eyes.

tf.s: We say She's got fair hair for a boy.
tf.why: For a boy we say He's got.

tf.s: In "The goat herd", a boy and his mum go out.
tf.why: Great! Mum and I like to go out.

tf.s: The boy puts boots on his feet.
tf.why: Well done! He puts on his boots.

tf.s: The boy has got some goat food in a bag.
tf.why: Yes! I have some goat food in a bag.

tf.s: The boy and his mum do not like to go out.
A picture shows a big nose. She's got a small nose matches it.
tf.why: Big and small are different, so it does not match.

tf.s: Sheep, feet and bees have the ee sound.
My mum's got means my mum has got.
tf.why: Yes! mum's got = mum has got.

boxes.q: Read: He's got brown hair. The boy has got brown hair.
Read: She's got a small nose. The girl has got a big nose.
boxes.why: Big is not small, so it is wrong.

boxes.q: Who goes out in "The goat herd"?
boxes.why: Mum and I like to go out.

boxes.q: What does the boy put on his feet?
boxes.why: He puts boots on his feet.

boxes.q: What does the boy have in the bag?
boxes.why: I have some goat food in a bag.

boxes.q: Who's in your family? Choose a good answer.
o: My mum, my dad, my brother and me.
boxes.why: We name the people in our family.

boxes.q: Which is a tricky word in the story?
Find an ee word in the story.

hunt.q: The boy goes out with his ___.

mcq.q: Which word is a family word?
mcq.why: A cousin is in our family.

mcq.q: What is the name of the graded reader?
mcq.why: The reader is The goat herd.

mcq.q: Which word is a hair colour?
mcq.why: Fair hair is a light hair colour.
My dad's got brown eyes is right.

mcq.q: Read and draw: She's got long black hair. Which picture?
o: A girl with long black hair
A girl with short fair hair
A girl with long red hair
mcq.why: The picture must show long black hair.

mcq.q: Tell your partner about your mum's nose.
o: My mum's got a small nose.
My mum's got a small noses.
mcq.why: My mum's got a small nose.

mcq.q: Why does the boy have goat food in his bag?
o: To give it to the bees

mcq.q: Which sentence does NOT match: a boy with brown hair and blue eyes?
o: He's got brown hair and blue eyes.
mcq.why: His hair is brown, not black.

mcq.q: Which group has the same sound as "sheep"?
mcq.why: Feet and bees have ee, like sheep.
